title: ACP order webhook signing and verification
summary: The merchant signs each order event with HMAC-SHA256; the agent checks the timestamp window and the signature before it trusts the event.

steps.label: Sign the raw body
steps.detail: Compute HMAC-SHA256 with the shared secret over the Unix timestamp, a dot and the exact raw body.

payload.content:
# Illustrative example, spec version 2026-04-17.
signed_payload = t + "." + raw_body
v1 = hex(HMAC_SHA256(secret, signed_payload))

steps.label: POST /agentic_checkout/webhooks/order_events
steps.detail: Header Merchant-Signature: t=<unix_seconds>,v1=<64_hex>. Body: type order_update with the Order.

steps.label: Verify, then process
steps.detail: Compare in constant time, then update the order view. Refunds, returns and disputes arrive as adjustments.

steps.label: 2xx acknowledgment
steps.detail: Any non-2xx answer tells the merchant the event was not accepted.
